title: Level 1 — Docking with the Space Station
subtitle: Carry cargo to the ISS and dock by flying the shuttle
briefing: The ISS orbits at about 415 km. Your shuttle starts lower, at 345 km, and the station is ahead.
Lower means faster: wait until the ISS is just ahead, then burn to climb up to it.
At 122 m from the port you fly it yourself with the thrusters. Contact must be slow and centered.
Everything comes out of one tank: the more cargo you carry, the less fuel you have to correct.
objectives: Dock with the ISS without crashing or leaving the approach corridor.
Stay above the fuel reserve: below it, the ISS calls an abort.
